summary: After rhaap:launch-job-template runs, its output is available as steps['<step-id>'].output.data: id (AAP job ID, number), status (e.g. pending, running, successful) and url (direct link to the job).
questions: How do I get the job status after launching from a template?
How do I reference the job URL from a launch step?

answer_card.title: rhaap:launch-job-template output
answer_card.answer_md:
| Reference | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `${{ steps['launch-job'].output.data.id }}` | number | AAP job ID |
| `${{ steps['launch-job'].output.data.status }}` | string | job status, e.g. `pending`, `running`, `successful` |
| `${{ steps['launch-job'].output.data.url }}` | string | direct URL to the job |
